title: glechoma rotundifolia
intro: Glechoma rotundifolia, commonly known as Creeping Thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its ability to alleviate respiratory issues, digestive problems, and anxiety due to its calming and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma rotundifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant's leaves and flowers can be used as a natural remedy for their antiseptic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant properties.
